admission: all finite, strictly increasing, completely regular source series; sampling step divides one day; first 40% contains at least 4 daily cycles plus 1 point; no label/correlation/performance filtering
period_selection: daily or weekly known candidate, requiring 4 cycles plus 1 training point; maximize training-only lag Pearson (undefined=-1), ties prefer shorter; no test values
clip_selection: NYC original validation only, fixed span12/tau3, cap candidates none/4/6/8: cap4 retained 4/6 injected hits, improved injected F1 .6154 to .6667 and background events 4 to 1. NYC is exploratory because historically exposed.
threshold_selection: per method: among validation background point-alarm fraction <=.01, maximize injected-validation event F1; tie minimize background point alarms, then prefer higher threshold. Fallback minimum background alarms, then max injected F1. All selections saved before any test label parsing.

isolation_forest.features: trailing min(24, daily period) raw observations; train-prefix standardization only

local_outlier_factor.features: same causal trailing vector and scaler as Isolation Forest

evaluation.rule: merge complete scored history then assign by first alert; one TP per closed NAB window; duplicates and outside events both FP; no point adjustment; not official NAB score
report: previously exposed versus newly evaluated series

scope: multi-series/multi-domain NAB benchmark, not a claim of validation on multiple independent benchmark collections; include every admitted result, including failures
